text:
Waiting areas mid-afternoon stayed on our minds, and we are grateful for your thoughts. We understand from your complaint that the pet handoff, the waiting area conditions, and the handling of your connecting travel left you feeling let down and worried about the care given to your animal companion.

Thank you for taking the time to raise this with Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and we take concerns about comfort, timing, and communication seriously. When a traveler reports a delay or a missed connection, we first review the travel record, the handling notes, and any station updates so we can see where service broke down and what support should follow. <<FACT F118>> We also want to be clear that our handlers are expected to use calm, humane methods at every step, with the animal's safety and stress level guiding each decision.

For the missed connection issue, we will review the booking file, the transfer path, and the notes from the operating teams to confirm what happened and what options are available. <<FACT F110>> If the complaint involves a lost crate, keep any tags, receipts, and handoff records together, since those details help us trace the item and move the case forward without delay. If you have already sent supporting documents, we will attach them to the file and keep the review moving. If you have not yet shared them, please send them as soon as you can so the case can be checked in full.

We also recommend that you keep a short list of anything you noticed during the trip, such as where the wait became difficult, when communication stopped, and whether the animal appeared stressed or unsettled. That kind of detail helps us improve the process for future travelers and better support animals in our care.

We are sorry for the trouble this caused, and we will work to address it with care and follow-through. Please stay in contact with the Companion Animal Travel Desk so we can keep you updated as the review continues.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
